summary.en-US: Adaptive offline buffering and auto-scroll for comics, webtoons and novels.

description.en-US:
Tunnel Reader is currently in beta.

The core reading features are functional, including adaptive cache-first buffering/offline reading and auto-scroll for comics and novels.

Some interface behaviour is still being refined. In particular, the floating Reader control may occasionally remain visible or fail to collapse when expected.

This early public release is intended for real-world testing. Updates and bug fixes will follow incrementally through Firefox.

release_notes.en-US: First public AMO release under the Tunnel Reader name. Includes adaptive cache-first buffering, reading resume, Wake Lock during active auto-scroll, and comic/novel auto-scroll. Known beta issue: floating-control visibility/collapse can occasionally be inconsistent.

version.approval_notes: Tunnel Reader is built from the human-readable TypeScript sources in src/ using the open-source esbuild dependency pinned in package-lock.json. Reproduction commands are documented in extension/README.md. The submission includes a source archive of the exact Git commit. The extension has no analytics, telemetry, remote code, or Reader backend. Broad HTTP/HTTPS matching is required because reader-page detection is site-agnostic; the content script exits early on pages that do not look like supported reading pages.
